description.value: Denny's is a Canadian family diner chain operating in Revelstoke for over 55 years under the 100% Canadian-owned Northland Properties group, offering all-day breakfast, lunch, dinner, and late-night menus. Situated along the Trans-Canada Highway corridor, it is a natural resupply stop for cyclists crossing the Selkirk and Monashee mountain ranges. The broad menu — from Grand Slams to burgers, salads, and kids' meals — caters to a wide range of dietary needs and appetites.
